# SplitPanel { #anylumino.SplitPanel }

```python
SplitPanel(
    widgets=None,
    *,
    titles=None,
    keys=None,
    orientation='horizontal',
    spacing=6,
    sizes=None,
    width='100%',
    height=420,
    resizable=True,
)
```

Lumino split panel with draggable dividers between children.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type                           | Description                                                                                                 | Default        |
|-------------|--------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------|
| widgets     | iterable or mapping            | Child widgets or keyed child mapping. Mapping keys become stable child keys and default titles.             | `None`         |
| titles      | iterable or mapping            | Optional labels associated with children.                                                                   | `None`         |
| keys        | iterable of str                | Stable child keys for iterable ``widgets``.                                                                 | `None`         |
| orientation | (\'horizontal\', \'vertical\') | Split direction. Horizontal places panes side by side; vertical stacks panes top to bottom.                 | `"horizontal"` |
| spacing     | int                            | Pixel spacing around Lumino split handles.                                                                  | `6`            |
| sizes       | iterable of float              | Initial relative pane sizes. Values are passed to Lumino as ratios.                                         | `None`         |
| width       | int, float, str, or None       | Widget width.                                                                                               | `'100%'`       |
| height      | int, float, str, or None       | Widget height.                                                                                              | `420`          |
| resizable   | bool                           | Whether the whole panel gets a notebook resize handle. Lumino pane dividers remain draggable independently. | `True`         |

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [layout_kind](#anylumino.SplitPanel.layout_kind) | A trait for unicode strings. |
| [orientation](#anylumino.SplitPanel.orientation) | An enum whose value must be in a given sequence. |
| [sizes](#anylumino.SplitPanel.sizes) | An instance of a Python list. |
| [spacing](#anylumino.SplitPanel.spacing) | An int trait. |
